$comment: The main menu's backgrounds (owner, 2026-11-08): 360° panoramas of real spots in a world, rendered from the game. Each: `name` (lowercase words joined by dashes; Settings stores it), `label` (Settings → On screen → Menu background shows it), `about` (what is there and how it was found), the world's `seed`, the camera's `position` (world m, eye height; the player is spawned there so the chunks stream in), `yaw` (degrees, 0 = +Z, 90 = +X: the heading at the image's left edge; the camera is level), `timeOfDay` (0–1, 0 midnight) and `image` (a file in shared/ui/menu-backgrounds/). `default` is shown until the player chooses; `turnS` the seconds for one whole turn behind the menu. `capture` is how `npm run panoramas` (client/scripts/panoramas.ts) shoots them: `steps` level shots round the circle in a square window of `sizePx` at `fovDeg`, stitched into one cylindrical strip `span` of the focal length above and below the horizon, WebP at `quality`, after waiting up to `settleS` for the terrain. A new background: an entry here, `npm run panoramas -- <name>` (a built client), then `node shared/ui/gen.mjs`; CI fails on stale output.

backgrounds.name: beach-peaks
backgrounds.label: Beach and peaks
backgrounds.about: Seed 0's nearest sea (bench goto: water, scope world, sea, 2 m deep), then the nearest sand above the water: a bay's beach with green hills and a snowy peak beyond.

backgrounds.name: river-bank
backgrounds.label: River valley
backgrounds.about: Seed 0's river near the spawn (bench goto: water, scope world, river, running at least 0.05 m/s): a stream between steep green banks.

backgrounds.name: lake-shore
backgrounds.label: Lake shore
backgrounds.about: Seed 0's nearest lake (bench goto: water, scope world, lake): a still lake by a meadow of pines, grey mountains with snow across it.
